description: Electronic band structure calculation along high-symmetry k-paths
workflow: TWO-STEP process: 1) SCF on uniform k-mesh → 2) non-SCF on k-path

step1_scf.description: Standard SCF to get converged charge density

step2_band.description: Non-SCF calculation reading charge density, on k-path

NBANDS.rule: increase 50-100% above default for sufficient empty bands

kpoints.example:
k-points along high symmetry lines
20
Line-mode
reciprocal
0.0 0.0 0.0  ! GAMMA
0.5 0.0 0.5  ! X

0.5 0.0 0.5  ! X
0.5 0.25 0.75 ! W
kpoints.note: Use SeeK-path or pymatgen to determine high-symmetry path for your space group

alternative_method.description: KPOINTS_OPT method (VASP 6.2+): both meshes in single run
alternative_method.note: Provide KPOINTS for SCF mesh and KPOINTS_OPT for k-path

hybrid_functional_band.note: Cannot use ICHARG=11 for hybrids. Use KPOINTS_OPT method or a zero-weight k-point approach.

soc_band.NBANDS: must be even, typically 2x non-SOC value
